name: Escalation matrix approvals
description: The Escalation matrix's approvals, shared by Contract Request to Execution, Generated Order Approval, Generated MSA Approval and Legal request intake (each starts it with a Workflow step and waits). It reads the deal from its Params, which the parent builds (Title, Side, DealValue, PayDays, Verdict, CoveredByDPA, TouchesData, ValueOver, and the document), and checks the rules in order, every matching rule adding an approver (each a task group), all on the parent's document, so a later approver (the CFO) sees the earlier approvals and their comments: a red triage verdict to Legal, a yellow one to Legal Operations; sell side over $1M (or a redline that took it over) to Sales Leadership and payment terms beyond Net 60 to Finance; buy side to Procurement; no existing DPA to Privacy; a vendor that touches Fontara systems or data to IT and Security. The first rejection ends it. It answers the parent's MatrixResult with Approved or Rejected (Update Parent Variable). A step that fails ends the run as Failed (the parent's run fails with it) and CLM emails the person who started the deal. Each approval is due 2 business days after it is assigned; past that it is escalated to the task group Approval Escalations (the department heads on Fontara IAM + CLM; the presenter where the site has no persona users), with the same Approve and Reject paths.
